summary: The new held profile-creation regression passes for known transport failure, unknown outcome, and ordinary success. Failure preserves the latest typed draft and rendered form, leaves the synthetic provider profile absent, makes no automatic write retry, and public:retry issues no write. Deliberate resubmission uses the latest draft and succeeds. The success control confirms a held successful request commits the values captured at submission, matching controller source semantics, then clears the create draft/form. Focused test 1/1; full controller suite 57/57 (56 existing plus this test); public-site suite 14/14.
